steps.title: Define Requirements

steps.title: Create Meta Data Configuration
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json containing application name and package identifier.

steps.title: Configure Color Resources
steps.description: Create colors.xml containing Material Light matching colors.

steps.title: Set Up String Resources
steps.description: Create strings.xml containing localizable application content and guide texts.

steps.title: Create Card Drawables
steps.description: Build custom drawable XML files for styled card containers.

steps.description: Create stylized XML shape templates for custom UI buttons.

steps.title: Design App Interface Layout
steps.description: Build modern and clean activity_main.xml layout with ScrollView, custom cards, and motivation section.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Establish AndroidManifest.xml structure, specifying launch activity, permissions, and native Material theme.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Environment
steps.description: Configure build.gradle to ensure strict compatibility with AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java to support guide categorization, interactive motivational quotes, and advice rendering.

steps.title: Verify Code Compliance
steps.description: Confirm Java 8 compatibility and ensure no prohibited external dependencies are loaded.

steps.description: Perform namespace validation checks on AndroidManifest.xml for compliance with compiler guidelines.

steps.title: Building How To Be Best
steps.description: Assemble debug APK containing clean assets and source code.
